title: Allow reordering of Bluetooth device list
line: The Bluetooth applet lets you add devices to Favorites, which are listed in their own section above the other disconnected devices.
explanation: The applet always sorted devices as connected first, then the rest alphabetically, so with many paired devices the ones used every day could sit far down the list with no way to move them up. The bluedevil developer advised against drag-and-drop reordering in the QML ListView. Each device now has an "Add to Favorites" / "Remove from Favorites" action; favorites are stored by address in the applet's config (favoriteDevices) and the proxy model lists them in a "Favorites" section between Connected and Available (connected favorites stay in Connected, sorted first).

commits.message:
applet: let users pin favorite devices above the others

With many paired devices the ones used every day could end up far down
the alphabetical list. Each device now has an "Add to Favorites" action,
and favorites are listed in their own section above the other devices.

BUG: 490982

media.caption: Master: an expanded device only offers Send File and Forget; there is no way to move it up.
Patched: the expanded device has an "Add to Favorites" action.
Master: disconnected devices are always alphabetical under Available.
Patched: Galaxy Buds2 and Pixel 8 are favorites and sit in their own Favorites section above Available.
Patched: a favorite that connects moves to Connected (listed first there) and returns to Favorites when it disconnects.
